title: Connected Coloring Games on Corona Products of Graphs
summary: We study the connected coloring game on corona products of graphs. For connected graphs $G$ and $H$, we prove the sharp upper bound $χ_{cg}(G\circ H)\leq\max\{Δ(G),Δ(H)+1\}+1$ and establish a further bound using the Bob-start ordinary coloring game on the second factor. We show that the difference between the Alice-start and Bob-start connected game chromatic numbers can be arbitrarily large in either direction. We further prove that a connected subgraph may have arbitrarily larger connected game chromatic number than its ambient connected graph, and that $χ_{cg}(G\circ H)$ cannot be bounded…
